description: App-command grants shared by every post-auth window: the event stream (`subscribe_events`) and `hydrateState()` re-reading identity/friends/community data on mount (each Tauri webview is a fresh JS context), and the intent gate's commit, cancel and undo (every window renders the review of its own calls). Every window applies the skin (`get_skin`) and reports one it could not apply (`report_skin_apply_failed`, plan SK2-T1: the window reports, the Host decides). Call and notification commands live with the windows that own them: the call shell in `app-buddy-list.json`, the active-call controls in `app-call.json`.
